title: Momoi Airi — What I Can Do For Them〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: What I Can Do For Them（2★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A joint stream, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad Haruka knows a lot of people but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, thank you for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're all done with committee stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we are. Also, you'd like to talk here instead of in class?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, um... Can you take a look at this? It has to do with what I'd like to do for our next video...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everything so far is getting a decent number of views, but there's one thing that's been bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is this about Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I sort of had a feeling this would happen, but she's really been getting short-changed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that's normal since we're still just starting out, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right, but I have to think Minori sort of feels the same way regardless of how much she's smiling...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. She even watches and rewatches each video to find out where she needs to improve so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was hoping to come up with a way to show everyone that Minori has just as much to offer as the rest of us, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm hoping that we can use the joint stream Haruka set up for us can act as a sort of springboard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why are you grinning?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad that we had the same idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want everyone to see just how wonderful Minori is as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The same idea, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, you say that it's the same idea, but I've sort of been where she is now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I went through this long period where no one saw me as a real idol. No one wanted me around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't want her to experience what I did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's my motive.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More than anyone else, Minori wants to give everyone hope for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She gave us all the courage to stand back up and become idols again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If people start to understand that, they'll all come flocking to her!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa... I really got worked up there, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand exactly how you feel, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: R-Really? I guess, good then...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But please let me know if you need any help, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! We're gonna do everything we can for her sake!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, about what I had in mind. I was thinking we could share something we're each good at...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then...
